sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.64 Dev

  • Media Studio folder tree: Added a nested MV-styled folder tree in Modules settings with leaf labels, line guides, counts, and quiet MV badges.
  • Shared tree state: Media Studio and Modules settings now share local expand/collapse state and keep it after reload.
  • Badge language: External folder rows now use MV product wording instead of the old EXT label.

v1.3.63 Dev

  • Migration UI Improvements: Polished Media Studio settings layouts to resolve text alignment and height rhythm.
  • State Syncing: Real-time toggle controls for hiding external sidebar folders.
  • Syntax Fixes: Resolved sidebar list node parsing syntax errors.

v1.3.62 Dev

  • Folder Hierarchy Display: Nested visual tree display showing only leaf names in the sidebar.
  • Folder-Plugin-to-MV Migration UI: Added a folder-plugin migration section under Media Studio settings in Modules settings. Added options to migrate all detected folders to local collections, toggle hiding of external folders in the sidebar, and confirm action.
  • State Synchronization: Real-time event communication between the settings panel and Media Studio for seamless layout updates without page reload.
